# Label check: does a relative-volume detector flag the candles Qriptal names? (generated by imb.py label-check)

Answer key: labels.json (22 named imbalance candles with a timeframe and a spoken price, 3 'no imbalance at this low' statements).
Data: Binance's own TF klines (data.binance.vision), spot and USD-M perp, BTCUSDT. Detector: volume / median(volume of the prior 50 bars of the same TF) >= k. A positive label is a HIT if at least one candle of that TF that closed before the video and opened within {'30m': 7, '1h': 7, '4h': 14, '12h': 30, '1d': 60} days of it matches the price (range +-0.4% or midpoint +-0.25%) AND is flagged.
Chance = probability of the same HIT if the same number of flags were scattered at random over that window: 1-(1-rate)^matches.
p = P(hits >= observed) under chance (exact Poisson-binomial). A detector that flags everything scores every hit and has chance 1: lift, not hits, is the measure.
